gaps.description: Simulate browser crash specifically to verify bookmark changes are saved.
gaps.rationale: The accepted case groups restart and crash together, but explicit verification after a crash event is a distinct abnormal/failure recovery scenario.

gaps.description: Attempt to drop a bookmark item onto a grandparent or unrelated node to confirm valid drop targets work while invalid ones fail.
gaps.rationale: Testing boundaries right outside self, immediate parent, and immediate child ensures the drop restriction is precisely scoped.

output.feedback: The test suite covers the primary positive paths and specified negative and batch actions well. Minor gaps exist in isolating the crash recovery scenario separately from restart and checking precise boundary drop targets.

cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark item, its immediate parent, and child exist. Steps: Attempt to drop a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its immediate child. Expected behavior: It is not possible to drop the bookmark item onto itself or its immediate parent or child.

cases.title: Verify valid versus invalid drop targets
cases.description: Preconditions: A bookmark item, its immediate parent, child, grandparent, and an unrelated node exist. Steps: Attempt to drop the bookmark item onto a grandparent or unrelated node. Expected behavior: The drop action is allowed for valid targets like grandparents or unrelated nodes, while restricted for self, immediate parent, and immediate child.

output.feedback: All test cases are fully grounded in their respective requirements, with clear and actionable preconditions, steps, and expected behaviors.

output.analysis: R-010: Abnormal scenario: Preconditions: Bookmarks have been modified. Action: Simulate a browser crash. Expected behavior: Bookmarks changes are saved over the crash event. R-018: Boundary scenario: Preconditions: A bookmark item, its immediate parent, child, grandparent, and unrelated nodes exist. Action: Attempt to drop the bookmark item onto a grandparent or unrelated node. Expected behavior: Valid drop targets work successfully while invalid ones fail.
